exam.title: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
exam.study_prerequisites: Hands-on Azure compute, storage, and networking administration plus strong TCP/IP, CIDR/subnetting, DNS, routing, VPN, firewall, load-balancing, encryption, high-availability, and troubleshooting fundamentals.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Design and implement core networking infrastructure
Design, implement, and manage connectivity services
Design and implement application delivery services
Design and implement private access to Azure services
Design and implement Azure network security services

review.notes: All five weighted July 27, 2026 objective groups and their subobjectives are mapped to a bidirectional packet-walk method, service comparisons, failure modes, two scenarios, eight labs, and 24 checks. Section 3 and Lab 4 provide requirements, configuration, validation, and troubleshooting depth for Azure Network Adapter and Azure Extended Network. The September 7 pass adds current virtual network flow-log, NSG flow-log retirement, and agentless Connection troubleshoot preview evidence. All 31 cited URLs are cataloged: 28 reachable, three O'Reilly/Udemy pages access-blocked, and none missing.

findings.resolution: Add SKU/limit table and worked capacity exercise.

findings.evidence: Current limitations qualify the older blog no-interruption statement.

findings.resolution: Add replacement, public-IP compatibility and controlled-cutover lesson.

findings.title: Default outbound change does not affect every existing VNet
findings.evidence: New private-by-default API behavior leaves existing VNets unchanged.
findings.recommendation: Scope the lifecycle lesson and require explicit egress for public dependencies.
findings.resolution: Scope the lifecycle lesson and require explicit egress for public dependencies.

findings.title: DNS ruleset links and application routes are independent
findings.evidence: Endpoint direction and forwarding-loop constraints differ from peering.
findings.recommendation: Add two DNS design patterns and loop diagnosis.
findings.resolution: Add two DNS design patterns and loop diagnosis.

findings.title: Internet fallback is not a universal private DNS repair
findings.evidence: NxDomainRedirect applies to Private Link zones at VNet-link scope.
findings.recommendation: Add DNS versus network/identity gates and qualified blog exercise.
findings.resolution: Add DNS versus network/identity gates and qualified blog exercise.

findings.title: Non-AZ gateway consolidation excludes Basic retirement
findings.evidence: Gateway, IP SKU and generation determine the applicable migration process.
findings.recommendation: Add inventory-first migration distinctions and region/zone caveat.
findings.resolution: Add inventory-first migration distinctions and region/zone caveat.

findings.title: Always On device tunnels need a different authentication stack
findings.evidence: Built-in IKEv2 computer-certificate device tunnel differs from Entra OpenVPN user access.
findings.recommendation: Close objective gap with prerequisites and explained check.
findings.resolution: Close objective gap with prerequisites and explained check.

findings.title: VPN backup capacity and failure boundaries need validation
findings.evidence: Same-location circuit links share a failure domain; private-peering backup capacity can be degraded.
findings.recommendation: Add survivor-demand exercise and failback/route evidence.
findings.resolution: Add survivor-demand exercise and failback/route evidence.

findings.title: Routing intent cannot preserve arbitrary custom hub routing
findings.evidence: Prerequisites and no automatic configuration rollback require planning.
findings.recommendation: Add export, route compatibility and symmetric-path constraints.
findings.resolution: Add export, route compatibility and symmetric-path constraints.

findings.title: Private endpoint routes have a specific UDR exception
findings.evidence: Policy must be enabled and /0 alone cannot override endpoint routing.
findings.recommendation: Qualify general route lesson and endpoint policy requirements.
findings.resolution: Qualify general route lesson and endpoint policy requirements.

findings.title: Direct Connect adds a bounded PLS preview
findings.evidence: No load balancer required, with destination, region, network-policy, ER and billing restrictions.

findings.resolution: Qualify conventional PLS description and add preview comparison.

findings.title: Backend TLS and probe success are separate observations
findings.evidence: Trust, expiry, SNI, association and test-probe behavior affect backend health.
findings.recommendation: Add diagnosis before changing production validation.
findings.resolution: Add diagnosis before changing production validation.

findings.evidence: April 28 retirement means unsupported resources and possible hardware decommission disruption.

findings.resolution: Use supported v2 labs and date the migration warning.
